author: Claude (AI). Not checked by a person. Written AFTER fixing against v1 and BEFORE running the code on it; same rubric as v1 (see g_listing_v1.json). Same AI wrote code and key: not independent.
origin_note: M01-M04 use real published specs (retyped, not copied sales text). M05-M07 and M13 use specs stored in our catalogue. M08-M12 are stress cases. Not verbatim seller listings (Q-033).
rubric_ref: eval/golden/g_listing_v1.json -> rubric_written_before_running_code (R1-R9). Two reminders: experience claims on one catalogue laptop need >=12 owners, 75% happy to support / 35% to contradict; a 30-point spread between a brand's laptops means mixed.
